This relies too much on its title, "War criminals," which suggests that the -3s did horrible th9ings and were contained in these stasis chambers. If this was meant to be ambiguous, well, the title should have been different.

Also, the transmission… Who intercepted it, where, by what means? (radio signal, TV signal, mail intercept, what us happening?) The reason I am picking at this is this: How did the Foundation know that this transmission has something to do with this item?

item.title: (no title)
item.content:encoded:
My take on the transmission is that it's intentionally ambiguous (on Tanhony's part) and can be interpreted in two ways:

  1. Humans almost entirely wiped out the colony of insect-people, the survivors sent a distress call to their homeworld and went into suspended animation. Having received the distress call, the homeworld is pissed off, and the transmission is a warning that humanity better surrender or be wiped out.
  2. The insect-people are here to protect us from some external threat. They tried to warn us, but we wouldn't believe them, so they went into suspended animation so they could be around to deal with the threat when it arrived. The transmission is a warning from their homeworld that the threat is incoming, with instructions on what must be done to prevent humanity from being wiped out. Unfortunately, something went wrong which prevented the remaining crew from being woken from stasis, and humanity is screwed.
